title: pentagonocarpus coulteri
intro: Pentagonocarpus coulteri, commonly known as Coulter's cottonball, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing fever, pain, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pentagocarpus coulteri include its ability to act as an anti-edematous agent, helping to reduce swelling, and its antimicrobial properties, which can combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
